source.numberingNote: eBible VPL code 4ES maps to traditional KJV 2 Esdras (not an additional book); SIR = Ecclesiasticus, WIS = Wisdom of Solomon.

EXO 20:10.verse: But the seventh day [is] the sabbath of the LORD thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that [is] within thy gates:

MAR 2:27.verse: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

LUK 24:1.verse: Now upon the first [day] of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain [others] with them.

ACT 20:7.verse: And upon the first [day] of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

1CO 16:2.verse: Upon the first [day] of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as [God] hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

REV 1:10.verse: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

ROM 14:5.verse: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

COL 2:16.verse: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath [days]:

HEB 4:9.verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

GEN 2:2.verse: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

GEN 2:3.verse: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

MAR 2:25.verse: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

MAR 2:28.verse: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

LUK 23:56.verse: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

ACT 2:42.verse: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

1CO 16:1.verse: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

ROM 14:13.verse: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in [his] brother’s way.

ROM 14:6.verse: He that regardeth the day, regardeth [it] unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard [it]. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

COL 2:17.verse: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body [is] of Christ.

HEB 4:4.verse: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh [day] on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

HEB 4:11.verse: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

EXO 20:8.verse: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

EXO 20:11.verse: For [in] six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them [is], and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

MAR 2:24.verse: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

LUK 24:3.verse: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

ACT 20:11.verse: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

ACT 2:46.verse: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

1CO 16:3.verse: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by [your] letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

ROM 14:3.verse: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

COL 2:22.verse: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

HEB 4:10.verse: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God [did] from his.

LUK 23:54.verse: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

MAR 3:4.verse: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
